summary:
Team 1love1future developed ASTROCARE, an offline-autonomous clinical decision support web platform . It combines an interactive 3D anatomical hologram, hands-free voice logging, and multi-day trend analytics with a deterministic five-stage rule-based engine monitoring eight core subsystems: blood pressure, heart rate, SpO2, VO2max, daily sleep duration, space radiation, skin abrasion, and skin rash.
ASTROCARE addresses deep-space healthcare challenges by eliminating dependence on real-time Earth triage. Operating 100% locally onboard, it filters out sensor artifacts, adapts clinical thresholds to mission context (microgravity vs. planetary surface, resting vs. EVA), compares seven-day trends against both pre-flight and personal in-flight baselines, and immediately guides standardized onboard countermeasures or packages asynchronous Houston telemedicine reports.
This capability is vital because signal delays and blackouts beyond low Earth orbit can turn manageable issues, such as chronic sleep deprivation, orthostatic intolerance, solar radiation spikes, or skin infections, into life-threatening emergencies. ASTROCARE empowers astronauts to safeguard crew health, cognitive readiness, and mission safety autonomously.
details:
ASTROCARE is an offline-first, bilingual (English / Vietnamese) Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) built on NASA-STD-3001 (Vol. 1 & Vol. 2) and OCHMO-TB-041 Rev. B operational guidelines. It monitors eight core physiological, environmental, and dermatological subsystems onboard spacecraft:

  1. Blood Pressure (SBP/DBP, Mean Arterial Pressure MAP, Pulse Pressure PP)
  2. Heart Rate (Resting vs. EXERCISE / EVA context-aware thresholds)
  3. Oxygen Saturation (SpO₂)
  4. Aerobic Capacity (VO₂max) (0G Free Space vs. Planetary Surface thresholds)
  5. Daily Sleep Duration (Actiwatch-L 2-minute epoch scoring + electronic Sleep Log, Sleep Efficiency, Latency, Awakenings, Daytime Naps, Circadian Phase Shift, Sleep Aids, and PVT-B alertness status)
  6. Space Radiation Dosimetry (hourly rate, daily dose, Solar Particle Event dose, and 600 mSv career cumulative limit)
  7. Skin Abrasion (wound area, tissue depth, bleeding status, pain, and infection signs)
  8. Skin Rash (Body Surface Area % BSA, vesicles/pustules, 12-hour spread rate, and fever)

At the core of ASTROCARE is a deterministic 5-Stage Rule-Based CDSS Engine:

  • Stage 1 — Sensor Plausibility & Context-Aware Thresholds: Blocks impossible sensor artifacts (e.g., inverted blood pressure or out-of-range probes) and adapts thresholds to activity state (RESTING vs. EXERCISE/EVA), mission environment (0G vs. Planetary Surface), concurrent acute symptoms, and PVT-B reaction status.
  • Stage 2 — Dual-Baseline Engine: Compares live readings against both a locked Pre-Flight Baseline (PMB) and an adaptive 7-Day In-Flight Personal Baseline (Median ± MAD), automatically falling back to PMB when fewer than 3 flight days are recorded.
  • Stage 3 — Personalized Deviation Analysis: Measures individual shifts (D% / Δ) relative to the astronaut's own baseline.
  • Stage 4 — Multi-Day Trend Analytics: Computes a 7-Day Moving Average (MA₇) and Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) daily slope, flagging PERSISTENT_DEVIATION after ≥ 3 consecutive abnormal days.
  • Stage 5 — Assessment, Insight & Action Protocols: Generates physiological root-cause insights, interactive onboard countermeasure checklists, cross-subsystem alerts (such as Systemic Co-Infection escalation), and packaged Houston Flight Surgeon Telemedicine reports.

The application spans six modules: Dashboard (interactive anatomical hologram + hands-free voice logging + 6 preloaded 7-day NASA mission scenarios), Monitoring (8-subsystem data entry, optical wound/rash scan simulation, and audit logs), Analytics (multi-layer 7-day SVG trend charts + CSV export), Health Evaluation, Missions (gamified daily preventive tasks), and Profile (dual baselines, mission environment switcher, and offline storage settings).

What Benefits Does It Have?

  • 100% Offline Autonomy: Clinical triage runs entirely locally in the browser, eliminating dependence on real-time Earth connectivity during deep-space latency or signal blackouts.
  • Transparent & Auditable Safety: Deterministic NASA rule-based logic prevents black-box AI hallucinations in safety-critical triage.
  • Personalized Early Warning: Dual-baseline tracking (Median ± MAD + PMB fallback) distinguishes normal microgravity adaptation from true individual physiological decline.
  • Proactive Fatigue & EVA Safety: Tracks cumulative sleep debt, circadian phase shifts, and PVT-B vigilance drops before high-risk EVA or docking operations.
  • Hands-Free Usability: Supports natural bilingual voice/text biometric logging alongside one-click scenario testing.

What Is the Intended Impact?

ASTROCARE aims to shift long-duration spaceflight healthcare from reactive, Earth-dependent monitoring to proactive, autonomous crew self-reliance—supporting astronauts aboard orbital stations, Artemis lunar surface missions, and future Mars transits. Beyond spaceflight, its offline-first, dual-baseline CDSS architecture also serves as a blueprint for remote, low-connectivity terrestrial environments such as polar research bases, submarines, maritime vessels, and rural clinics.

Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware & Software Used

  • Languages & Web Stack: TypeScript, React 19, HTML5, Tailwind CSS v4
  • Visualization & UI: Custom interactive SVG/CSS anatomical body hologram, custom multi-layer SVG telemetry charts, Lucide React, Motion
  • Backend & Optional Multimodal Parsing: Node.js, Express, tsx, @google/genai (server-side Gemini API for optional hands-free voice/audio parsing, paired with offline regex fallback)
  • Build, Persistence & Testing: Vite 8, browser localStorage offline persistence, Node.js test runner (node:test + tsx) with automated unit tests across all 5 CDSS stages, and TypeScript strict checking (tsc --noEmit)
  • Domain Standards Modeled: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 & Vol. 2, OCHMO-TB-041 Rev. B, NASA Sleep Evidence Report, Actiwatch-L 2-minute epoch actigraphy workflows, electronic Sleep Logs, and Reaction Self-Test (PVT-B)

How Is Your Project Creative?

  • Living Anatomical Hologram: Instead of hiding numbers in dense tables, the central hologram syncs its heartbeat pulse animation to live heart rate and maps all 8 subsystems onto color-coded anatomical pods (Heart, Lungs, Brain / Sleep & Radiation, Muscles / VO₂max, Skin) for instant visual triage.
  • Safety-First Hybrid Architecture: Cleanly separates input convenience (optional natural-language voice parsing) from clinical decision-making (a 100% deterministic, verifiable 5-stage NASA rule engine).
  • Closed-Loop Gamified Countermeasures: Links detected anomalies directly to daily preventive missions—such as electrolyte loading, ARED workouts, circadian dimming, < NC-40 sleep-quarter noise control, and recovery naps—with readiness points and badges to encourage sustained crew adherence.

What Factors Did Our Team Consider?

  • Clinical Safety & Regulatory Boundaries: ASTROCARE is explicitly scoped as an operational decision-support prototype following NASA-STD-3001 protocols—not a diagnostic or prescribing device—and avoids unverified AI clinical guesses.
  • Context & False-Alarm Prevention: Accounts for physiological differences between RESTING vs. EXERCISE/EVA vitals, 0G vs. Planetary Surface VO₂max requirements, and Actiwatch-L false-immobility removal via sleep logs and daytime nap aggregation.
  • Sensor Fault Resilience: Tier-1 plausibility guards isolate faulty cuff or probe spikes so noisy readings never corrupt 7-day personal baselines, while < 3 days missions fall back seamlessly to pre-flight baselines.
  • Bandwidth Constraints & International Crews: Designed for 100% offline browser persistence, lightweight asynchronous Houston telemedicine packets over intermittent Ku-band/S-band links, and full bilingual (English / Vietnamese) operation.
